title: Complement isomorphism under completed affine base change
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $J,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves on $Y$, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism which is an isomorphism over $Y\setminus V(K)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. For an affine open $U$ put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$, $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $L=K(U)R$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ and let $Q$ be the ideal sheaf associated to $L$. Let $g:S\to Y$ be the spectrum of the completion map followed by the inverse affine chart and the inclusion of $U$. The projection $p:X\times_Y S\to S$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is an isomorphism over $S\setminus V(Q)$. No properness, flatness or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: The Mathlib formulas mem_support_iff_of_mem and fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus identify the preimage of the support of K in Spec B with the prime-spectrum zero locus of K(U). Membership in U follows from range_fromSpec.

The formulas coe_support_ofIdealTop, zeroLocus_span and Spec_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus identify Q support with the zero locus of L. preimage_comap_zeroLocus identifies this with the preimage of K support under g. Taking complements gives Q support complement equal to g inverse of K support complement.

Put V equal to K support complement and W=g inverse V. The restricted map t satisfies t followed by V inclusion equal to W inclusion followed by g. The two isomorphisms pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g W inclusion and pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f V inclusion t identify the restricted projection with a base change of the given isomorphism. Their snd identities and pullback_snd_iso_of_left_iso prove it invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem completedAffine_complement_base_change
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl)))
    (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
    let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
    let L := (K.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R)
    let Q := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (L.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom)
    let g : Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ Y :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B R)) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι
    IsIso (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) (Scheme.Opens.ι Q.support.compl))
